controllerAdapters: Synthetic stored worker/campaign fixtures, mocked campaign-manager and JavaScript identity lookup only. The frozen model, verifier and child parser are real.
qualified: Frozen-ledger or earlier validated timeout is required before skipping a source. Equal/future timestamps cannot authorize that skip.
Nonzero network counts, boolean/float execution counters, source-execution claims and mismatched child Python/parser identities are rejected.
A partial sweep can resume, finish and be revalidated without replacing its earlier partial or complete summary.
Two source revisions sharing the same exact source/applied pair reuse one validated pair result. Fresh attempts, reused receipts and completed AST pairs are counted separately.
Cache metadata is validated even when its sidecar hash is internally consistent. A changed frozen model copy is rejected.
Independent formula failures and citation ambiguities remain investigation-required even when the synthetic product gate accepts the endpoint.
An explicitly simulated observer timeout remains investigation-required and is not counted as a completed AST comparison.
limitations: These are finite controls of the independent observer infrastructure, not the completed corpus observation.
The frozen model checks seven declared reference, table, protected-literal, media and category invariants. It does not prove all factual prose or all native template expansion.
The timeout control is simulated, with no60-second test or real known-timeout source repeated.
